extracted.intended_audience: scholars and readers of Renaissance natural philosophy; readers of Latin early-modern scientific/philosophical texts
extracted.subtask_description: Full-text digital transcription (OCR) of Girolamo Cardano's De subtilitate libri XXI — a Renaissance treatise on natural philosophy, principles of things, elements, and numerous natural-history observations. The page is a primary-source text rather than a guideline or evaluation rubric.
